lines: Kestra: Aldo's apprentice? Good. The storm tore Rifts open, past Thornridge and under the Saltmarsh.
Kestra: Everyone wants them closed. I'm not so sure: new Spirlings came through. But start north in Fernstair.
Kestra: And this blew in through my window. Mirela's compass rose. Yours, I think.
Kestra: Still mending Rifts? Fine. Just look closely at what comes through before you do.

maps: Old maps of Veydal, crossed out and redrawn in three colours of ink.

lines: Examiner Hollis: The guild keeps a board for people who finished the story and could not stop.
Examiner Hollis: Pick something. Lose at it. I take notes.
